newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on Tokyo, Europe sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on Tokyo, Europe sales.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold closed lower on Wednesday compared to the previous New York close on continued selling from Japan and from Europe in the afternoon session, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$347.40/90 an ounce against New York's US$348.30/80 close on Tuesday.
"There was selling from Japan as usual," said one trader.
Gold dealers said the still-strong dollar was not helping the gold market.
The market saw some support from Australian buyers, but fresh sales when Europe opened pushed gold down.
Sentiment was said still bearish with no clear direction, although traders said gold would test lower levels as it had failed to break above $350 per ounce.
Local gold ended HK$14 lower at HK$3,219 a tael.
Physical demand was far from brisk, dealers said.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to +2.00 from its previous fix at nil.
